tasks.name: Plugin Upgrade
tasks.description: Review and update all installed WordPress plugins to their latest secure versions and verify compatibility.
tasks.notes: Updated WooCommerce (9.4.0), Yoast SEO (23.9), and Elementor (3.25.1). Compatibility tested in staging.

tasks.name: Theme Upgrade
tasks.description: Review and update active and installed WordPress themes to ensure design integrity and security patches.
tasks.notes: Astra Pro theme updated to v4.8.2. Child theme template overrides verified.

tasks.name: WP-Config Code
tasks.description: Implement required security, debug, and performance configurations in the wp-config.php file.
tasks.notes: Pending security salts update and memory limit raise to 512M.

tasks.name: PHP Version
tasks.description: Record and verify the server PHP runtime version meets WordPress minimum security and performance requirements.
tasks.notes: Server upgraded to PHP 8.3 with OPcache active.

tasks.name: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
tasks.description: Configure and enforce two-factor authentication (2FA) on administrative and editor accounts.
tasks.notes: Configured via Wordfence 2FA for all users with Administrator and Editor roles.

tasks.name: User Accounts and Email Addresses
tasks.description: Audit WordPress user accounts, assign least-privilege roles, and verify associated email addresses and 2FA status.
tasks.notes: Audited 3 administrative accounts. Stale developer credentials removed.

tasks.name: Elastic Email
tasks.description: Configure, authenticate (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and send test emails via Elastic Email SMTP relay.
tasks.notes: DNS SPF and DKIM verified; SMTP test email queue still pending client verification.

tasks.name: Website QA (Quality Assurance)
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive QA checks: accessibility, navigation & links, forms, responsiveness, page load speed, and critical functionality.
tasks.notes: Checkout flow, gravity forms, SSL certificate, and responsive mobile navigation fully tested.

tasks.name: WordPress Core Upgrade
tasks.description: Review WordPress core installation, apply latest security and maintenance release, and confirm database updates.
tasks.notes: WordPress Core updated to 6.7.1 without database errors.

tasks.name: Off-site Cloud Backup
tasks.description: Run full snapshot of database and uploads to AWS S3 prior to updates.
tasks.notes: Full snapshot (1.4 GB) verified in AWS S3 Frankfurt bucket.

tasks.name: Malware & Security Scan
tasks.description: Deep integrity scan of core files and wp-content uploads folder.
tasks.notes: Zero malware signatures found. File integrity check 100% clean.

tasks.name: Cloudflare CDN Cache Purge & SSL Validation
tasks.description: Purge edge cache and verify TLS 1.3 full encryption mode.
tasks.notes: Pending edge cache purge verification after staging review.
